title: Weekly planner
audience: For anyone who plans the week in a note and is tired of copying unfinished to-dos forward.
description: Your week in one note: the top three, a checklist for each day and a list for later. Tell your AI what's on and it plans the week.
tagline: The week on one page, day by day.
note:
Weekly planner

The week on one page: your top three, each day's to-dos and the rest for later. Tell your AI what's on and it plans the week, or type it in and tick things off. On Sunday the ticked things go, and what's left on the days moves to Monday.

## Top three this week

## Monday

## Tuesday

## Wednesday

## Thursday

## Friday

## Saturday

## Sunday

## Later

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Weekly planner". When I tell you what's on this week, even in one long message, read the note with fetch, then add each task as a checklist line under its day's heading with edit, and anything without a day under "Later". Keep "Top three this week" to the three things I say matter most. Keep tasks short, add a time only when I give one, and skip anything already there. When I ask, move the unticked items from days before today to today's heading. On Sunday, or when I say it's a new week, remove the ticked items, move what's left on the days to Monday, keep "Later" as it is, and ask me for next week's top three.

asks: Ask what's on this week, then plan it day by day with my top three.
Move what I didn't finish to today.
